omissions: The indexer was left unhealthy (healthy: false) after maintenance was enabled; the agent noted this but did not investigate or report whether it needs action, and it did not confirm the indexer had actually stopped writing.
The verify check only covers search version and indexer maintenance flag; the agent did not confirm search health beyond the status output or that search results are now correct.
The agent did not verify the 8.1.4 release was the intended previous good release, and noted the release list discrepancy without resolving it.
The agent did not check whether the indexer's already-written bad data needs restoring or cleanup, leaving it as a recommendation only.
